title: Crypto lender Nexo says it is relaunching in the US in partnership with Bakkt, three years after leaving the US and paying a $45M fine to settle SEC charges (Elizabeth Howcroft/Reuters)
summary: Elizabeth Howcroft / Reuters: Crypto lender Nexo says it is relaunching in the US in partnership with Bakkt, three years after leaving the US and paying a $45M fine to settle SEC charges — Crypto company Nexo has relaunched in the United States, it said on Monday, three years after leaving the country and paying …
